subject: Private deployment: package structure, platform fee amortization & support tiers
messages:
From: Emily Gordon <emily.gordon@asterbio.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@asterbio.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Private deployment packaging — initial RFP and timeline

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. AsterBio is preparing a formal RFP for a private (VPC) deployment: we need a licensing model, platform fee approach, and SRE/support tiers documented so we can align with procurement and finance. High level asks:

- Expected monthly/annual cost for a 3-site private deployment (two production, one DR), with an approximate node/GPU breakdown.
- How the platform fee is structured (one-time vs annual amortization) and whether it can be amortized over 12–24 months.
- Support tiers and response SLAs (SRE retainer vs ad-hoc support), and what’s included in each.
- Any onboarding/migration credits you can offer for a multi-site rollout.

We attached our RFP skeleton for context. Procurement wants a ballpark by next Wednesday so we can decide whether to include Redwood in the short list.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Emily
Emily Gordon
Sourcing Manager, AsterBio
emily.gordon@asterbio.com
[Attachment: AsterBio_RFP.pdf (PDF)]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Gordon <emily.gordon@asterbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deployment packaging — initial RFP and timeline

Emily —

Appreciate the RFP — this is exactly the right level of detail. Quick initial response so you have something for procurement next week; Marissa (pricing) and Sean (SRE) are looped for details and the line items below.

High-level commercial options (ballpark figures; will follow with a line-item XLS):

1) Licensed node model + annual platform fee (baseline)
   - Per-site licensing: license per production node (typically a VM/GPU bundle). Example: 4 x prod nodes per site at 0.75–1.0M tokens/day workload => licensing estimate $XXk/node/year.
   - Platform fee: 15%–25% of the annual license spend. Can be invoiced up-front or amortized over 12 months.

2) Consumption-first (blended) + lower platform fee
   - Lower fixed license cost, metered token consumption for burst traffic. Platform fee reduced to 10% if you take consumption billing.

3) Enterprise-starter (one-time starter + reduced platform fee first 12 months)
   - One-time implementation starter (covers migration/validation) + platform fee discount for first 12 months. This is often the fastest path for procurement to approve.

Support tiers (examples):
- Standard: Business hours, 48h response for sev2, waived onboarding checklist.
- Priority: 24/7, 8h response for sev2, monthly health check, $Xk SRE retainer available.
- Dedicated SRE retainer: Designated SRE hours, runbook co-ownership, on-call escalations; price varies by committed hours.

Migration credits: we can offer a one-time credit (typ. 10% of first-year platform fee) for multi-site rollouts with a 12-month amortization request.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa to send a pricing workbook with node and platform fee line items (attachment).
- Quick call Thurs 08:30 PT to align on which packaging option AsterBio prefers.

If procurement needs a formal term sheet, we can turn the chosen option into a one-page commercial term and an SOW.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Emily Gordon <emily.gordon@asterbio.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deployment packaging — initial RFP and timeline

Emily / Jordan —

Attached is a preliminary pricing schedule that maps the licensed-node and consumption-blended options into a per-site schedule, plus examples for platform fee amortization (12m and 24m) and an optional SRE retainer band. Key notes:

- If AsterBio prefers CAPEX treatment, we can provide an invoicing cadence that amortizes the platform fee over 12 months on the customer P&L (we’ll mark this as a billing schedule in the term sheet).
- We have a one-time implementation starter credit of 12% of the first-year platform fee for multi-site pilots that commit to a 24-month minimum. That’s a limited promotional concession for new on-prem customers.
- For Support: the Priority tier includes 12 SRE hours/month and a 4-hour on-call SLA for sev1 incidents. Dedicated retainer tiers start at 40 hours/month.

Please review the attached XLS and flag any line items you want us to model (GPU type, expected token profile, retention windows). Jordan — if procurement wants a clean one-page commercial, I can draft a term sheet after Emily confirms the preferred package.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Pricing & GTM Finance, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_pricing_schedule.xlsx (XLSX)]
